card.fires_on: Forms of confess and admit (confessed, confess, admit, admitted) and the start of Confessions, where someone owns up to a crime, sin or fact.

modes.example: The man, thus charged with the crime, a Mohammedan,<< confessed>> and was led away to punishment.
